metadata.source: Trip-based SCC portfolio optimisation for Greater Melbourne

p50.label: Permanent P50 delivery
p50.description: Central delivery case using permanent protected-infrastructure benchmark costs.

lowcx.label: Low-complexity protected delivery
lowcx.description: Optimistic cost bound for uncomplicated protected retrofit; not established as feasible for every corridor.

net.label: Maximise net benefit
net.description: Selects program scale as well as location and may leave funding unspent.

benefit.label: Maximise benefits within funding
benefit.description: Uses the available funding to extend the program, even after marginal returns fall below one.

caveats: Research prototype: selected corridors are model outputs, not funded projects or engineering recommendations.
Locations inherit uncertainty in SCC matching, existing-facility classification, route choice, uptake and delivery cost.
Benefits are out-of-sample present values. Project-level popup benefits are singleton values and are not additive because projects interact.
